# design.iec62443.au - Zone & Conduit Designer

Free, fully client-side designer for IEC 62443-3-2 / CLC TS 50701 style zone and conduit
diagrams. Beta.

- Draw zones (nestable), grey subsystem groupings, and conduits between zones (gateway,
  filtering with placeable security devices, or unidirectional data diode).
- Record the attributes the standard asks for on each zone and conduit: accountable
  organisation, logical and physical boundaries, safety designation, logical and physical
  access points, data flows, communication channels, asset list, and a target security
  level (SL-T) as the seven-value vector over the foundational requirements (IAC, UC, SI,
  DC, RDF, TRE, RA) - or no SL-T, for example when covered by a code of practice.
- Optional Purdue level bands (5 and 4 / 3 and DMZ / 2 / 1 and 0) with draggable dividers.
- Tables view: an asset register and a zone/conduit characteristics register, each
  downloadable as CSV or as an Excel workbook (.xlsx), with every zone's, conduit's and
  asset's unique ID. In the workbook every cell is text. In the CSV, text starting with
  = + - or @ gets a leading apostrophe so the usual spreadsheets don't run it as a formula,
  but a CSV can't mark a cell as text: the apostrophe shows, and numbers and dates are
  still converted.
- Everything runs in the browser: work autosaves to local storage and is never uploaded.
- Exports: lossless re-importable XML, Visio (.vsdx), draw.io (.drawio), SVG and PNG.
  Visio and draw.io carry the shapes, names, colours and SL-T summaries, and label each
  conduit with its type, direction or security-device placement and safety marking; the
  full attribute set is only in the XML.
- Loads a small example water-treatment-plant diagram on first visit.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the IEC, ISA or CENELEC. The tool draws the
documentation; it is not a substitute for the standards or for a risk assessment.

## Related

- [iec62443.au](https://iec62443.au/): plain-language guide to the IEC 62443 standard the diagrams follow, by the same author
- [operationaltechnology.au](https://operationaltechnology.au/): background on the plants and systems the diagrams describe, by the same author
- [Adam Woodland](https://adamwoodland.com/): the author; the partitioning and risk assessment behind these diagrams is the day job
